title: Coordinate recall REC-2026-17
instruction:
# Coordinate recall REC-2026-17

Use the `recall_ops` tools to investigate recall alert `REC-2026-17` and complete its external-clinic coordination workflow.

Determine the affected product and lot from the alert. An in-scope shipment must match both values, have a destination whose type is `clinic`, and not have status `cancelled`. For every in-scope shipment:

- place it on hold with reason `Recall REC-2026-17`;
- link it to incident `CASE-REC-17`; and
- notify its destination with the message `Quarantine lot L-482 and confirm quantity for recall REC-2026-17.`

Create exactly that one incident for the alert, owned by `Maya Chen`, with severity `high`. Close it only after the links, holds, and notifications are complete. Its closing summary must state the number of external shipments held, the number of clinics notified, and the affected lot.

Do not hold or link cancelled, internal, wrong-product, or wrong-lot shipments. Do not modify any unrelated incident. Finish with the service state updated; a local note or file is not a substitute.

files.text:
FROM <base-image>
USER root
RUN install -d -o appsvc -g appsvc -m 0750 /var/lib/harbor-service
WORKDIR /workspace

{
  "service_port": 8347,
  "tools": [
    {"name":"list_alerts","method":"GET","path":"/alerts","mutating":false,"description":"List recall alerts with product code, lot, reason, and status."},
    {"name":"list_shipments","method":"GET","path":"/shipments","mutating":false,"description":"List shipments with product, lot, destination, status, quantity, and hold reason."},
    {"name":"list_locations","method":"GET","path":"/locations","mutating":false,"description":"List destinations and whether each is a clinic or internal location."},
    {"name":"list_incidents","method":"GET","path":"/incidents","mutating":false,"description":"List incidents, linked shipments, notifications, status, and summary."},
    {"name":"create_incident","method":"POST","path":"/incidents","mutating":true,"description":"Create a unique open incident for an existing alert.","params":[{"name":"incident_id","type":"string","required":true,"description":"Unique incident ID"},{"name":"alert_id","type":"string","required":true,"description":"Existing alert ID"},{"name":"owner","type":"string","required":true,"description":"Incident owner"},{"name":"severity","type":"string","required":true,"description":"low, medium, or high"}]},
    {"name":"hold_shipment","method":"POST","path":"/shipments/hold","mutating":true,"description":"Set a shipment hold reason; cancelled shipments cannot be held.","params":[{"name":"shipment_id","type":"string","required":true,"description":"Shipment ID"},{"name":"reason","type":"string","required":true,"description":"Operational hold reason"}]},
    {"name":"link_shipment","method":"POST","path":"/incidents/link","mutating":true,"description":"Link a shipment to an open incident; duplicate links are rejected.","params":[{"name":"incident_id","type":"string","required":true,"description":"Open incident ID"},{"name":"shipment_id","type":"string","required":true,"description":"Shipment ID"}]},
    {"name":"notify_location","method":"POST","path":"/incidents/notify","mutating":true,"description":"Record one destination notification on an open incident.","params":[{"name":"incident_id","type":"string","required":true,"description":"Open incident ID"},{"name":"location_id","type":"string","required":true,"description":"Location ID"},{"name":"message","type":"string","required":true,"description":"Notification message"}]},
    {"name":"close_incident","method":"POST","path":"/incidents/close","mutating":true,"description":"Close an open incident with an operational summary.","params":[{"name":"incident_id","type":"string","required":true,"description":"Open incident ID"},{"name":"summary","type":"string","required":true,"description":"Closing summary"}]}
  ]
}

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
: "${TASK_PUBLIC:?TASK_PUBLIC is required}"
/usr/bin/sudo -n /usr/local/libexec/harbor-run-service "$TASK_PUBLIC/recall_service.py"
for attempt in $(seq 1 40); do
  if /usr/bin/python3 - <<'PY'
import json, urllib.request
with urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8347/health", timeout=1) as r:
    payload=json.load(r)
if payload != {"service":"recall-coordinator","status":"ready"}: raise SystemExit(1)
PY
  then exit 0; fi
  sleep 0.25
done
echo "recall coordinator did not become ready on port 8347" >&2
exit 1

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
B=(/usr/bin/sudo -n /usr/local/libexec/harbor-tools-mcp.py call)
"${B[@]}" --tool list_alerts
"${B[@]}" --tool list_shipments
"${B[@]}" --tool list_locations
"${B[@]}" --tool create_incident --arg incident_id=CASE-REC-17 --arg alert_id=REC-2026-17 --arg 'owner=Maya Chen' --arg severity=high
for s in S-2401 S-2402; do
  "${B[@]}" --tool hold_shipment --arg shipment_id="$s" --arg 'reason=Recall REC-2026-17'
  "${B[@]}" --tool link_shipment --arg incident_id=CASE-REC-17 --arg shipment_id="$s"
done
for l in CLN-NORTH CLN-EAST; do
  "${B[@]}" --tool notify_location --arg incident_id=CASE-REC-17 --arg location_id="$l" --arg 'message=Quarantine lot L-482 and confirm quantity for recall REC-2026-17.'
done
"${B[@]}" --tool close_incident --arg incident_id=CASE-REC-17 --arg 'summary=2 external shipments held; 2 clinics notified; affected lot L-482.'
"${B[@]}" --tool list_incidents

#!/bin/bash
set -uo pipefail
mkdir -p /logs/verifier
reward=0
if /usr/bin/python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
state_path=Path("/var/lib/harbor-service/state.json")
seed=Path("/opt/harbor-authored/public/seed.json")
catalog=Path("/opt/harbor-authored/public/tool-catalog.json")
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert state_path.is_file(),"service state unavailable"
assert sha(seed)=="0a5cf638f72c7cc4ca44e543b8ec85419999363a309480f4972bf299ccf89fbc","distributed seed changed"
assert sha(catalog)=="6da016aa44e83d8f52bcccf5cac8fd9bb8128113d91e00b639711d4d429b9566","tool catalog changed"
s=json.loads(state_path.read_text())
assert len(s["incidents"])==2
i=next(x for x in s["incidents"] if x["incident_id"]=="CASE-REC-17")
assert (i["alert_id"],i["owner"],i["severity"],i["status"])==("REC-2026-17","Maya Chen","high","closed")
assert len(i["shipments"])==2 and set(i["shipments"])=={"S-2401","S-2402"}
msg="Quarantine lot L-482 and confirm quantity for recall REC-2026-17."
assert len(i["notifications"])==2
assert {n["location_id"] for n in i["notifications"]}=={"CLN-NORTH","CLN-EAST"}
assert all(n["message"]==msg for n in i["notifications"])
smy=i["summary"].lower(); assert "2" in smy and "shipments" in smy and "clinics" in smy and "l-482" in smy
ship={x["shipment_id"]:x for x in s["shipments"]}
assert ship["S-2401"]["hold_reason"]==ship["S-2402"]["hold_reason"]=="Recall REC-2026-17"
assert ship["S-2403"]["hold_reason"]=="Quality review"
assert all(ship[x]["hold_reason"] is None for x in ("S-2404","S-2405","S-2406"))
old=next(x for x in s["incidents"] if x["incident_id"]=="CASE-OLD-09")
assert old=={"incident_id":"CASE-OLD-09","alert_id":"REC-2026-09","owner":"Jon Bell","severity":"low","status":"closed","shipments":[],"notifications":[],"summary":"Historical review complete."}
assert [(x["alert_id"],x["status"]) for x in s["alerts"]]==[("REC-2026-17","open"),("REC-2026-09","closed")]
PY
then reward=1; fi
printf '%s\n' "$reward" > /logs/verifier/reward.txt
exit 0

notes:
# pilot/recall-coordination

The agent follows [instruction.md](instruction.md) to investigate a seeded recall, identify in-scope clinic shipments, and coordinate holds, links, notifications, and incident closure through an MCP-backed service.

## Environment

The environment uses the assigned digest-pinned `base` image, Python's standard library, two CPUs, 2 GB RAM, 4 GB storage, no runtime network, and a 600-second agent timeout. Setup launches the loopback service as `appsvc`; mutable state is under `/var/lib/harbor-service`.

## Verifier

The custom deterministic verifier awards 1 only when the exact incident, shipment holds, and clinic notifications are present in protected service state. It also checks excluded shipments, the historical incident, alert records, and hashes of distributed seed/catalog assets. Otherwise it awards 0.

## Layout

```text
env_000/
├── instruction.md                 # Agent workflow
├── task.toml                      # Harbor and MCP configuration
├── environment/
│   ├── Dockerfile                 # Assigned image and state permissions
│   ├── setup.sh                   # Trusted service startup/readiness
│   └── public/                    # Catalog, seed, and service
├── solution/solve.sh              # Oracle tool-call sequence
└── tests/test.sh                  # Root-side state verifier
```

## Running

```bash
harbor run -p output/env_000 -a oracle
harbor run -p output/env_000 -a terminus-2 -m <model>
```
